title.en: Nise Seijo da to Iwaremashita ga, Douyara Watashi ga Honmono no you desu ka?
Akugyaku Seijo desu ga, Aisuru Danna-sama no Oyaku ni Tachitai desu. (To wa Ie, Kirawarete Iru no desu ga)
Ane no Migawari de Konyaku shitara Naze ka Henkyou no Seijo to Yobareru you ni narimashita
Uchi no Outaishi Denka wa Kyou mo Gu Kawaii ~Konyaku Haki desu no? Mochiron Kyakkashimasu keredo, Riyuu wa Kiite Sashiagemasu wa~
Danna-sama ga Chicchai Mofumofu ni narimashita ~Watashi wo Akujo da to Gokai shiteita no ni, Subete Gibo no Uso da to Kizuita you desu~
Shikkaku Seijo no Gekokujou - Sasensaki no Akuma na Shinpu-sama ni Naze ka Dekiaisareteimasu
Kao Dake Seijo na no ni, Shi ni Modottara Reikoku Datta Koushaku-sama no Hon'ne ga Ama Sugimasu!
Himegimi wa Wakaki Shougun ni Oboreru
Oshi ni Muchuu na Tensei Heroine desu ga, Mishiranu Momoiru Yurufuwa Ouji ni Dekiai Kouryakusareteimasu
Ouhi ni Naru Yotei Deshita ga, Nise Seijo no Omei wo Kiserareta no de Toubou Shitara, Koutaishi ni Dekiai Saremashita. Sochira mo Douzo Oshiawase ni
Kanpeki Sugiru ga Kosando mo Konyaku Hakisareta Reijou wa Ringoku no Outaishi to Musubareru!?
Kyou kara Akujo ni narimasu! Tsukaisute no Migawari Seijo Nante Gomen desu
Konyaku Haki wa Honmou desu! Seijo no Chikara ga Kaika Shita no de Watashi wa Jiyuu ni Kurashimasu - Honmono no Seijou wa Gishi de wa Naku Watashi deshita
Ryuujin-sama to Miko Hanayome no Chigiri
